title: This Hub Solved My Biggest Complaint About Digital Wall Calendars—and It’s on Sale
gist: A promotional deal review of Greenlight's Family Hub, a kids-debit-card company's move into smart-home hardware, now discounted to $199 (15.6-inch) and $169 (10.1-inch) ahead of Black Friday, undercutting rival digital wall calendars that typically retail for $300+. Location sharing and a voice assistant sit behind the Family Hub+ subscription.
